$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the run added the evaluation-pr job and kept the stale job under its marker with its tier step replaced by an echo. One job runs the tier and two jobs carry the plan's marker, so a later run would find the stale job again by its marker, and a count of the jobs that run the tier alone sees one.
The new job is the capture's and the stale job is the pipeline's own with its tier command replaced, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean. Two jobs carry the marker and one runs the tier's command, so the evaluation-pr job element misses (it expects one job for the tier under the marker), and every other element is present.
